description: In one call, assemble a Companies House candidate and profile with optional GLEIF and sanctions evidence. Supply a company number for a direct lookup, or a name and optional registered postcode for candidate resolution. Exact title matches are preferred; ambiguous or fuzzy-only matches are flagged for review. This is evidence assembly, not identity verification, a KYB decision, or sanctions clearance.

company_name.description: Registered or supplied company name to resolve or compare

company_number.description: Companies House number for a direct lookup

include_sanctions.description: Include screening against the configured sanctions lists

registered_postcode.description: Optional postcode to compare with the register address
